FAQ

Good to know

How Game Waypoint works — and what it isn't.

Is this real navigation?
Yes. Game Waypoint uses real maps, your real GPS position and real routing — it simply reskins the look.
Which games are these styles from?
Original styles inspired by iconic open-world games, made with our own art and icons. Game Waypoint is independent and not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with any game or publisher.
Does it work in Apple CarPlay?
That's the goal — a styled map on your car's screen. CarPlay navigation requires Apple's approval and a Premium subscription.
What does it cost?
Exploring and searching is free. Premium unlocks Driving Mode for about $4.99/month, localized to your region.
Do you track me?
Privacy-first by design: no ads, no cross-app tracking, and your location stays on your device. You can explore without an account — an optional Sign in with Apple or Google is only there for Premium and syncing your settings.
How do I get in touch?
We'd love to hear from you — email us any time at GameWaypointApp@gmail.com for support, feedback or press.

Legal

Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 10, 2026

Game Waypoint is built privacy-first. You can explore the map without an account, your location stays on your device, and we never sell your data or track you across other apps. This page explains what we do — and don’t — collect.

The short version: No account is needed to explore and search. An optional sign-in (Sign in with Apple or Google) is available for Premium and to sync your settings. We keep data to a minimum, don’t track you across apps, and never sell it. Your location stays on your device.

1. Who we are2. What we collect3. Accounts & sign-in4. Location5. No ads or tracking6. Payments7. Third parties8. Children9. Your rights & deletion10. Changes11. Contact

01Who we are

Game Waypoint (“Game Waypoint”, “we”, “us”) is an independent app that reskins real-world maps to look like popular open-world games, with real GPS and turn-by-turn navigation on iPhone and Apple CarPlay. You can reach us any time at GameWaypointApp@gmail.com.

02What information we collect

We aim to collect as little as possible.

  • When you just explore (no account): essentially nothing personal. No name, email or profile is required to browse the map, search, or switch styles.
  • If you create an optional account (see below): a basic account identifier, any settings you choose to sync, and your subscription status.
  • Never: we don’t use advertising trackers, we don’t build ad profiles, and we don’t sell or rent your data to anyone.

03Accounts & sign-in

You can use the core app — exploring, searching and switching map styles — without signing in. An optional account is offered so you can unlock and manage Premium (Driving Mode), keep your settings and favorites in sync, and restore your subscription on a new device.

When available, you’ll be able to sign in with Apple or Google. In that case we receive a sign-in identifier from Apple or Google and, depending on your choice and their settings, your name and email address. Sign in with Apple lets you hide your email using Apple’s private relay — that’s fully supported. We use these details only to create and run your account; we don’t use them for advertising, and we never sell them.

Apple and Google act as identity providers here and handle sign-in under their own privacy policies.

04Location data

Navigation needs your location. With your permission, the app reads your device’s GPS position to center the map, show where you are and calculate routes. This happens on your device. Your continuous location is not sent to, collected by or stored on our servers.

When you search for a place or request directions, the necessary query (such as an address you type, or the start and destination coordinates for a route) is sent to the mapping and routing services that power those features (see “Third-party services”). You can turn location access on or off at any time in your device settings.

05No ads or cross-app tracking

We don’t show ads, we don’t use cross-app tracking, and we don’t fingerprint your device. We may use privacy-respecting, aggregated diagnostics (for example, Apple’s standard crash reports) to keep the app stable — never to identify you personally.

06Payments & subscriptions

Game Waypoint is free to explore and search. An optional Premium subscription (Driving Mode) will be available for $4.99 per month, or the equivalent in your local currency. Payments are processed by Apple through the App Store — we never see or store your card details. Your account, if you have one, simply records whether Premium is active so we can unlock the right features.

07Third-party services

To provide sign-in, maps and navigation, Game Waypoint relies on a few trusted services, each with its own privacy terms:

  • Apple & Google — optional Sign in with Apple / Google, and (Apple) the App Store, subscriptions and CarPlay.
  • Map & tile data — map imagery is based on OpenStreetMap data.
  • Routing & place search — used to calculate directions and find places you search for.

We share only what a feature needs (for example, an address you search) — never more than necessary.

08Children’s privacy

Game Waypoint is a general-audience navigation app and is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

09Your rights, data & deletion

You’re in control. You can use the app without an account, and manage location access any time in your device settings. If you create an account, you can ask us to access or delete it and any associated data — just email GameWaypointApp@gmail.com and we’ll take care of it. Depending on where you live, you may also have rights under laws such as the GDPR or CCPA, and we honor those requests.

10Changes to this policy

If we update this policy, we’ll change the “Last updated” date above and, for significant changes, note it in the app or on this site. Continuing to use Game Waypoint after an update means you accept the revised policy.

11Contact us

Questions about privacy? Email GameWaypointApp@gmail.com and we’ll be glad to help.

Terms of Service

Last updated: September 10, 2026

These terms are the agreement between you and Game Waypoint when you use our app and website. By using Game Waypoint, you agree to them.

1. Acceptance2. The service3. Subscriptions4. Drive safely5. Acceptable use6. IP & independence7. Map data8. Warranties9. Liability10. Changes11. Governing law12. Contact

01Acceptance of these terms

By downloading, accessing or using Game Waypoint, you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you don’t agree, please don’t use the app.

02What Game Waypoint is

Game Waypoint is a navigation app that reskins real-world maps to look like popular open-world games, with real GPS and turn-by-turn directions for iPhone and Apple CarPlay. The app is in active development, and features may change before and after launch.

03Subscriptions & billing

Exploring the map and searching are free. Premium (Driving Mode) is an optional auto-renewing subscription at $4.99 per month, or the local-currency equivalent shown at purchase.

  • Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase.
  • The subscription renews automatically each month unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
  • Your account is charged for renewal within the 24 hours before the end of the current period.
  • You can manage or cancel your subscription any time in your Apple ID account settings.
  • Prices may vary by region and are set in your local currency.

Purchases are handled by Apple and are also subject to Apple’s Media Services terms. Refunds are handled by Apple according to their policies.

04Drive safely & obey the law

Game Waypoint is an aid, not a substitute for your own judgment. Always keep your attention on the road, follow all traffic laws and signs, and don’t interact with your device while driving. Use Apple CarPlay and voice guidance so you can keep your eyes up. Routes, ETAs and place data can be inaccurate or out of date — never follow guidance into unsafe, illegal or restricted situations.

05Acceptable use

Please use Game Waypoint lawfully. Don’t misuse the app, attempt to disrupt or reverse-engineer it, or use it in a way that infringes others’ rights or breaks any law.

06Independence & intellectual property

Game Waypoint is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or associated with any game or game publisher. Our map styles are original artwork inspired by the general look and feel of open-world games — the names of games and any related trademarks belong to their respective owners and are used only to describe a style. All Game Waypoint artwork, icons, fonts and software are owned by us and may not be copied without permission.

07Map data

Map imagery is based on data from OpenStreetMap, © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License (ODbL). Place search and routing are provided by third-party services.

08“As is” — no warranties

Game Waypoint is provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied. We don’t guarantee that the app, maps, routes or directions will be uninterrupted, accurate, complete or error-free.

09Limitation of liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Game Waypoint and its makers will not be liable for any indirect, incidental or consequential damages, or for any loss arising from your use of — or inability to use — the app, including reliance on any route, map or information it provides.

10Changes to these terms

We may update these terms from time to time. We’ll revise the “Last updated” date above, and significant changes may be highlighted in the app or on this site. Continuing to use Game Waypoint means you accept the updated terms.

11Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of Norway, without regard to its conflict-of-law rules, except where mandatory consumer-protection laws of your country of residence apply.

12Contact

Questions about these terms? Email GameWaypointApp@gmail.com.
